facts.claim: uv issue #8949 exists, is open, opened 2024-11-08, requests cargo-like workspace.dependencies (shared dependency versions for members)
A maintainer states uv does not support this yet and that standards compliance for project.dependencies is the blocker
Issue #15808 was marked as a duplicate of #8949
No merged or open PR, branch or commit implementing shared workspace dependency version inheritance was found in uv

Members can declare { workspace = true } under [tool.uv.sources] to resolve from the local workspace; root sources are inherited by members; a single uv.lock at the root; member version constraints are still declared per member (no version inheritance mechanism in docs)
Grading surface of about 300 hidden CLI scenarios with snapshots

spike_plan.kill_if: Subset run is not deterministic; spec cannot be pinned without leaving combinations open; or a single-dependency path takes more than a day to get passing.
spike_plan.pass_if: Baseline fails deterministically on head; subset run is identical across 3 reps; spec pins syntax and merge rules for every combination the hidden set will test; basic path produces a stable lock snapshot.
steps: In a networked throwaway container, clone astral-sh/uv at 2b50cbc0 and run cargo build --locked -p uv; time it (smoke build was 249 s).
Run a subset of the existing lock/sync/add test binary (not the full suite) three times to check determinism and per-test results; drop tests that are flaky or time out.
Create a 3-member workspace fixture with a root dependency table and a member { workspace = true } reference; run uv lock on head to confirm it fails, establishing the baseline.
Write a one-page spec pinning the root table key, the member reference syntax, and how extras, markers and dev groups merge; list the combinations the hidden cases will test.
Implement only the basic resolve path for one plain dependency (about 150 lines) and check one lock snapshot against the spec.
Record build time, subset flakiness, and whether the spec can be pinned without leaving combinations undefined.

v1.summary: Issue #8949 is real, open since 2024-11-08, Apache-2.0, and no implementation or open PR was found, so lookup is none and the seed is not a copy of public work. It is killed (K4) because the hidden snapshots test undisclosed combinations and the root table syntax is unspecified; fix the spec and the smoke build (amber: 249 s build, full test run timed out at 600 s, 13 flaky) before a spike.
